metadata.title: chore: update CI uv action and linted YAML
metadata.author: lucarlig

description:
## 🔗 Related Issue
Closes #N/A

---

## 📝 Summary
This PR updates all GitHub Actions `astral-sh/setup-uv` pins to `v8.1.0` to remove the Node.js 20 deprecation warnings from CI. It also fixes the `yamllint` issues in the touched workflow and compose YAML files, and refreshes `.secrets.baseline` after the line-number shifts.

---

## 🏷️ Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature / Enhancement
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor
- [x] Chore (deps, CI, tooling)
- [ ] Other (describe below)

---

## 🧪 Verification

| Check                     | Command         | Status |
|---------------------------|-----------------|--------|
| YAML lint                 | `uv tool run yamllint==1.38.0 -c .yamllint .github/workflows tests/migration/docker-compose.test.yml docker-compose-performance.yml docker-compose-debug.yml` | Passed |
| CI workflow validation    | `pre-commit run check-ci-workflows --all-files` | Passed |
| Secret baseline check     | `pre-commit run detect-secrets --all-files` | Passed |
| Pylint (mcpgateway)       | `uv tool run --with-editable . --with pylint-pydantic==0.3.5 pylint==3.3.9 mcpgateway --rcfile=.pylintrc.mcpgateway --fail-on E --fail-under=10 --jobs=0` | Passed |
| Unit tests                | `make test`     | Not run |
| Coverage ≥ 80%            | `make coverage` | Not run |

---

## ✅ Checklist
- [ ] Code formatted (`make black isort pre-commit`)
- [ ] Tests added/updated for changes
- [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable)
- [x] No secrets or credentials committed

---

## 📓 Notes (optional)
- Root cause: CI was pinned to an older `setup-uv` release that still emitted GitHub's Node 20 deprecation warning.
- Scope is limited to workflow YAML, compose YAML whitespace cleanup, and the generated `.secrets.baseline` refresh required by pre-commit.
